title: Northgate Tire Center Road Hazard Protection — Terms and Conditions
content:
# Road hazard protection: terms and conditions

These terms govern road hazard protection on a Northgate Tire Center package that includes it.

## 1. What is covered

1.1 On a package with road hazard protection, a tire damaged by a cause the package covers is replaced with a new tire of the same item.

1.2 Damage from collision, vandalism, off-road or racing use, improper inflation or mechanical faults of the vehicle is not a road hazard.

1.3 A matching full-size spare bought in the set is covered where the package covers the full-size spare.

## 2. When a replacement is made

2.1 **Term.** A road hazard replacement is made only when the damage is brought to a Tire Center no later than the package's road hazard term, in calendar months, after the installation date of the package. Calendar months are added to the installation date and, when the resulting month has no such day, the boundary falls on that month's last day.

2.2 **Tread.** A tire is covered only while its remaining tread, as measured on the work order, is above the package's coverage-end tread depth.

2.3 **Count.** A package receives at most the package's allowed number of road hazard replacements, counted as the road hazard replacement entries recorded on the package.

All three conditions are read from the system's records — the package's installation date, the tread measured on the work order and the replacement entries on the package — and each must hold for the replacement to be made.

## 3. How the replacement is priced

3.1 **Credit for the damaged tire — no longer in force.** The clause "the damaged tire is credited at the full price paid per tire when its wear is at or below the package's full-credit wear limit, and otherwise at the price paid per tire multiplied by the tire's remaining usable fraction of tread" is no longer in force; it has been superseded by the current basis for the road hazard credit.

3.2 The new tire is charged at the current tire price under the package's replacement tire price basis — the regular price in effect on the service date for the tire's item number on Northgate In-Club Purchase, as recorded in the item price history — so the member pays the difference between that charge and the credit.

3.3 Mounting, balancing and a valve stem for the replacement are free where the package includes them for road hazard replacements, and are charged at the package's price per tire otherwise.

3.4 A credit is applied only to the replacement and is never paid out in cash while the package does not allow a cash payout.

3.5 The replacement keeps the package's remaining term where the package so provides.

## 4. The term, worked through (hypothetical dates)

| Installation date | Term | Last day the damage may be brought in | Brought in on | Result |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 2023-06-15 | 60 months | 2028-06-15 | 2028-06-15 | within the term (the boundary day itself counts) |
| 2023-06-15 | 60 months | 2028-06-15 | 2028-06-16 | outside the term; no road hazard replacement |
| 2024-02-29 | 36 months | 2027-02-28 (February 2027 has no 29th) | 2027-02-28 | within the term |
| 2024-02-29 | 36 months | 2027-02-28 | 2027-03-01 | outside the term |

## 5. Tread and count, at the boundary (hypothetical figures)

- With a coverage-end depth of 2/32 inch, a tire measured at 3/32 inch is covered; a tire measured at 2/32 inch is not.
- On a package allowed 2 replacements, a package already showing 1 road hazard replacement entry can receive a second; a package already showing 2 cannot receive a third.
